visual.general_description: Bed Mobility line chart of CARE item score by week across ICU, IPR and outpatient phases.
visual.detailed_description: Line chart titled "Bed Mobility" on a white background with grid lines. The y-axis is labelled CARE Item Score with tick labels 0 to 6; the x-axis is labelled Weeks with tick labels starting at 1 and including 17 and 55 at the right end. A legend shows three colours: ICU in orange, IPR in gray and Outpatient in yellow. Two vertical dashed blue lines separate the three phases, and the line colour changes at the same positions. The line stays at the lowest tick for the first weeks, rises stepwise through the ICU phase, rises further during IPR, drops back at the IPR to outpatient boundary, and then steps up three times during the outpatient phase to its highest level at the end.
